name: Code Review Diff
summary: The story as a pull request: Pulse is the status check that keeps running after merge and posts a suggested rollback that only a human can apply.
look: Warm off-white review UI with a line-number gutter, red strike-through and teal + diff lines, status checks and review threads in JetBrains Mono, with an Instrument Serif PR title. Coral marks the failing check and the merge/CTA button.

components.name: Status checks list
components.role: CI ticks, then Pulse as the always-on check

motion.name: Hunk unfold
motion.how: height tween 0.4 s power2.out, starts on a downbeat

motion.name: Line strike-and-replace
motion.how: strike drawn left to right 0.3 s, + line slides in y 8 to 0 on the next 1/8

motion.name: Checks pipeline
motion.how: spinners resolve with 0.5 s stagger, one per beat, failure on the snare

story: Hook: a merged Friday PR with every CI check green and production marked 'nobody watching'; 'And the drop still shipped on Friday.' Reveal: a diff strikes '38 dashboards, checked by hand' and adds '+ Acme Pulse'. Proof: the production-watch check fails, the checkout.conversion hunk unfolds, and Pulse's review comment reports checkout conversion −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231 with a suggested rollback; the human clicks Roll back. CTA: 'Caught before customers noticed.' above a merge box with the lockup and a coral Start free button.
adapt: Express your before/after as a diff and your core alert as a review comment with a suggested change; the merge button becomes your CTA.

fit.risk: non-developers may not read diffs; keep hunks to 2-3 plain-language lines
